title: calendars MemoryBackend::get_availability: use the -34 BusyStatus/IncludeInAvailability helpers
description: Found in spec-sync batch 1. MemoryBackend::get_availability still returns [] so the reference backend never exercises BusyStatus::for_event and IncludeInAvailability::counts_event (added for JMAP-lehj.2, -34 §2.2). Implement availability in the memory backend with those helpers and test it end to end.
notes: Decision (Mark, 2026-11-15): UTC subset, refuse the rest. No tz database or RRULE expansion in the memory backend; a relevant event with timeZone other than UTC/Etc/UTC, recurrenceRules or recurrenceOverrides makes getAvailability serverFail instead of being omitted.
close_reason: Memory get_availability implements -34 §2.2 with the BusyStatus/IncludeInAvailability helpers for UTC/floating events; recurring or non-UTC relevant events fail with serverFail (Mark's choice); 5 tests. Handler null-vs-omitted issue filed as JMAP-lehj.13
